summary: Provision the embedded agent's existing private state directory before Core-local startup (BUG-0149). API impact: existing contract; restores API availability without changing its schema or authorization.

guide.reason: Restores documented clean-install startup; no operator permission workaround or new workflow is required.

api.reason: API impact: existing contract. Core-local startup exposes the same authenticated local API and embedded-agent enrollment/reporting; no request, response or caller contract changes, so the API reference needs no update.

roadmap.reason: Corrects a release blocker; does not declare the installation or production gate passed.

state.reason: The systemd unit securely provisions the existing embedded-agent state directory; no new state model is added.
state.record: /var/lib/nex-core-agent/state.json on Nex Core retains host/pool identity and enrollment state; a fresh Controller recovers inventory through existing Core enrollment and reports.

verification.method: Actual fifth-ISO install reproduced the restart failure. Package regression failed before the unit change and all 15 checks passed afterward. The independently audited seventh ISO installed on a new blank disposable disk, booted without ISO media, and retained healthy Core service with zero restarts and both directories root-owned 0700 across host reboot. Installed binary/source matched the audited artifacts; local browser login passed. Independent live-host review accepted bounded BIOS evidence. Existing Python discovery runs in both CI workflows; hosted CI and broader production certification remain open.
